info.title: Banking API
info.description:
This API provides a comprehensive set of functionalities for managing core banking operations, including customer accounts, transactions, and financial data retrieval. Adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance requirements.

**Operational Details:**
- **Logging & Audit Trails:** All API requests and significant state changes are logged for auditing purposes. Logs include request/response payloads, timestamps, and originating IP addresses.
- **Service Level Agreements (SLAs):** The API aims for a 99.9% uptime. Specific endpoint response time targets and error rates are detailed in the accompanying SLA documentation. Clients should implement appropriate retry mechanisms with exponential backoff.
- **Timeouts:** API endpoints are configured with a maximum processing timeout of 30 seconds. Requests exceeding this duration will be terminated and return a 504 Gateway Timeout error (not explicitly modeled here but implied by operational context).

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

CursorParam.name: cursor
CursorParam.description: A cursor for pagination, indicating the starting point of the next page. Typically an opaque string.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key to prevent duplicate requests. Max 255 characters. Clients should generate a unique UUID for each new request.

XRequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
XRequestIdHeader.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for tracing and debugging across services. Clients should generate a unique UUID for each request.

XCorrelationIdHeader.name: X-Correlation-ID
XCorrelationIdHeader.description: A unique identifier for a series of related requests, useful for end-to-end tracing of a business process. If not provided, a new one will be generated.

RateLimitLimit.description: The maximum number of requests permitted in the current rate limit window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds.

400BadRequest.description: Bad Request - The request was malformed or invalid.
